text: The one breaking change this week is #13326, which makes five test-only IsHandled events in Fabric Platform Mgt internal, renames the Fabric mirroring app, and drops the unused Key Vault client-ID lookup; #12557 adds first-party app authentication to the same export. Posting and tax fixes dominate the rest. #13458 and #13203 correct additional-currency amounts, #13415, #13310, #13248 and #12474 fix non-deductible and reverse-charge VAT, and #13272 and #12430 address FX and source currency handling. India GST gets #13342, #13334 and #12979. Other fixes cover vendor remittance export hanging when sorted by Document No. (#13255, #13294), French payment slips (#13134), FatturaPA file names (#12292) and Norwegian SAF-T totals (#12696). Subscription Billing received #12796, #12519, #12998 and #13240, and the WIP transfer Bin Code fix landed as #13166 and #13293. Sales Order Agent and Expense Agent changes include #12821, #13256, #12147 and #12539. Copilot bank reconciliation can now switch LLM by configuration (#13303), and Shopify tax matching moves to a newer model (#13052). New items include the Report Filename Manager app (#12610), EET 2.0 for Czechia (#9839) and German e-invoice buyer identifiers (#12691). Extensibility and performance work includes #10992, #13111, #13261, #13262 and #11222.

issues: Minor omission: #13326 also replaces the pseudo-audit telemetry events with real audit logs (Audit Log.LogAuditMessage). The paragraph leaves this out, but nothing it says is wrong.

Several pull requests are listed by number with no description: the Subscription Billing group, the Sales Order Agent and Expense Agent group, and the extensibility and performance group. This is accurate but less useful to a reader. For example, #12147 adds corporate card support to the Expense Agent and #12539 adds a V2 consumption API and a trial.

Notable fixes are left out: #13403 (duplicate records from EC Sales List Suggest Lines), #13220 (average cost adjustment overflow), #13159 (multi-document reminder PDF) and #12083 (customer-to-contact sync). This is acceptable for a summary.
